general_information.title: Drought-tolerant rice variety evaluated in field trials with smallholder farmers
general_information.description: AfricaRice researchers developed a drought-tolerant rice variety and evaluated it in field trials with smallholder farmers. The trials compared performance with locally used varieties under water-limited conditions. Researchers and participating farmers documented the findings to inform the next stage of validation. This example describes a development-stage output rather than claiming adoption or impact.
